messages:
maria: Hey team — incoming customer request to onboard sprite-8b (open-source) for low-latency chat. They want a quantized offering and latency <= 80ms p95 on 1k tokens. Can we triage? :eyes:
triage-bot: New intake: sprite-8b from customer Acme Labs. Priority: customer-request. Required: privacy (no data share), 4-bit quant preferred, perf SLO. Link: https://huggingface.co/acme/sprite-8b
alex: First pass: need model weights + tokenizer + config. Also ask if they require generation sampling reproductions (top_p/top_k) or just greedy. Maria, did they send an example prompt set?
maria: They sent a short evaluation set (10 prompts) and want deterministic-ish replies for LLM completion. I'll add the prompts to the intake ticket.
sam: OK. For quantization plan I suggest: PTQ q4_k_m run -> compare with int8 dynamic if available -> run perf smoke on dedicated A10x4. Quick checklist I run: compile -> test generation correctness -> perf microbench.
li: I can pick up the q4_k_m run. Plan: convert checkpoint via hf->llama-converter then use our quant script. Quick command I usually run:
```bash
python tools/quantize.py --model hf/acme/sprite-8b --out /tmp/sprite-q4 --bits 4 
```
will also run calibration on 1000 random tokens from their prompts.
alex: Add these acceptance criteria to thread: 1) quality delta <= 3% vs fp16 on BLEU/ROUGE/LLM-eval metrics for their prompt set; 2) latency p95 <= 80ms; 3) mem footprint fits a single V100 (or target infra). If any fail, fallback policy -> serve fp16 on dedicated.
sam: For eval metrics, we'll run: ppl/perplexity, embedding-sim cosine against fp16 outputs, and a simple QA exact-match for the sample set. I'll script this and post results.
li: Started quant job, ETA ~2h. Posting logs to S3 when done. Will also snapshot inference logs for token breakouts.
maria: Thanks. If q4 fails quality threshold, we should consider mixed approach: prefix cached in fp16 and remainder q4. Can we test prefix caching impact? :thinking_face:
alex: Yes, we can add prefix caching test. Sam, li — please add a small variant: warmup sequence of 64 tokens in fp16 then continue q4 and measure delta.
sam: Noted. I'll add warmup variant to the perf matrix. Also adding smoke checklist for on-call deploy: 1) model pinned hash, 2) canary route, 3) fallback to fp16, 4) metric alerts.
triage-bot: Intake updated: sprite-8b -> assigned to li (quant) and sam (eval). SLA: 3 business days for first results.
li: Quant job finished — initial q4_k_m outputs look slightly blurrier. Quick numbers vs fp16 on the sample: embedding cosine mean 0.982, ppl +2.1%, token diffs mostly on stop sequences. Uploading diffs now.
sam: Good numbers. I'll run the perf suite tomorrow morning and post p50/p95. If p95 < 80ms and quality within thresholds, we can mark as candidate for canary.
maria: Great. Let's sync tomorrow 10am to decide rollout. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
